claims.summary: For every d>=2 in characteristic zero, the dimension-four primitive boundary F has exact order d(d-1) at the generic point of every two-pair collision stratum. For the generic four-conic smoothing and parity-dependent focused twist specified in the source, H1(L) is killed by epsilon, with dimension two for even d and one for odd d; the section-lattice index is 5d(d-1)+2.
claims.assessment: Working proof by vanishing after twisting down the complementary three-conic subcurve, cohomology and base change, injective restriction of extending sections, and a generic moving-mark Wronskian. Combined with the prior lower bound this gives equality for F only. Exact orders of m1 and k, tangent cones, local polar/colon lengths and first-step thresholds remain open.
claims.rationale: Settles the boundary-order part of the all-degree two-pair conjecture and computes the remaining focused cohomology. It does not determine the polar residual speciality or close a top-level open statement; novelty is not claimed.
claims.next_action: Check nonvanishing of the two skipped-column minors on the actual extending series, then retain leading-form data for the polar/colon contribution.

conj:cube-two-pair-order.mathematical_status: Exact two-pair order of F is proved uniformly in characteristic zero; m1 and k have the earlier lower bound only. The other conjectured statements remain open.

conj:cube-two-pair-order.assessment: Conjecture, partially proved. In characteristic zero thm:cube-two-pair-order-lower-bound gives order at least d(d-1) for F,m1,k; thm:cube-two-pair-boundary-order proves equality for F in every degree. Exact companion orders, tangent-cone factors and the triple-stratum assertion remain open. Retained modular d=2,3,4 observations are evidence for those remaining parts.
